items.q: What do shortcuts ultimately cost a tax function?
items.a: Shortcuts buy a saving today and a problem tomorrow, whereas the long horizon buys goodwill that quietly waits to help; the choice between them is, in the end, a choice of character.

items.q: How does well-governed tax become a form of leadership?
items.a: When done well, tax ceases to be a mere function and becomes a form of leadership, since the quiet confidence of a well-governed function is felt far beyond the tax department itself.

items.q: Why close a leadership message with a measured, parallel cadence?
items.a: A measured triad — stewardship over shortcuts, partnership over opposition, the long view over the quick win — leaves the listener with a rhythm worth remembering, which a sprawling summary never could.
